candidate.title: RAG vs Fine-tuning (n8n) #n8n #rag #finetuning
candidate.description: In this video, you'll learn the differences between Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and fine-tuning models. RAG allows AI systems to access vast amounts of data using a vector database, while fine tune allows for further model optimization . See how these concepts work together in a simple n8n workflow.
